meta.title: A user limited to the PR's location and category is shown

steps.note: Enable the filtering behavior required by the case.
Open Purchase Requisitions as the starting screen for the PR flow.
Keep the requisition list on the Open tab.

args.goal: Find PR-1 for Gurgaon, select one of its line-item checkboxes, click the Assign person control next to Upload PRs, type User E in the Search a user box, and stop with the assignee results visible showing User E (Food Buyer Gurgaon).

steps.note: Perform the PR line-item assignment flow and verify the expected user is visible in the filtered assignee list.
